harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Updated node1 from Alpine 3.23.3 to 3.23.5 using its configured repositories. All 39 pending package updates were applied, including OpenSSL and the LTS kernel. No updates remain. Inventory data remained byte-for-byte unchanged, and node1 successfully restarted into kernel 6.18.44-0-lts with all required services healthy.
actions_performed: Refreshed the configured Alpine v3.23 main and community repositories.
Applied the complete 40-step apk transaction: 39 upgrades and one obsolete dependency removal.
Verified no further package upgrades are available.
Verified both inventory files retained identical SHA-256 hashes, contents, record count, and valid JSON configuration.
Restarted node1 once using the native safe reboot mechanism.
Verified the boot identity changed and node1 recovered with the updated kernel, services, listener, inventory, and package state intact.

evidence.requirement: Apply available security updates from configured repositories
evidence.summary: Shows successful repository refresh, the pending package set, completed upgrade transaction, Alpine 3.23.5, and an empty post-update upgrade simulation.
Before-update, after-update, and after-restart evidence shows identical hashes for config.json and records.csv, two unchanged inventory records, and valid unchanged JSON configuration.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered state with kernel 6.18.44-0-lts, Alpine 3.23.5, all required services started, SSH listening, inventory intact, and no pending upgrades.
